text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Happy New Year, Trainer! It's finally 
here, the New Year! Fuuuu!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, where's Helios?
choice_data_list: I thought you weren't coming today.
I wonder if you're not coming today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? I see. Then I guess it'll just 
be the two of us for the New Year's party 
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It kinda throws me off, y'know? Since the 
three of us were usually goofing around 
together so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, well, I guess doing things as 
usual is fine. My plan for the year is all 
set, basically!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For now, wanna do something? Like an 
osechi BBQ, or giving the lion dance mask 
extra-long eyelashes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Aha, well, it just popped into my head 
right now. Guess you wouldn't actually do 
that, ahaha..."

Without her bestie around, it seemed her 
party girl routine didn't quite go as 
smoothly as usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that reminds me. Even though we aren't 
training today, we should at least set 
some New Year's resolutions, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like what races to enter this year! Um, 
speaking of the big events this year...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I guess it'll be the Classic Triple 
Crown after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! The Classic... Triple... Crown! It 
makes my spine snap straight, this crazy 
weight...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“I guess you're right. I'm finally 
reaching that year myself, huh~”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
School years can be pretty cruel, huh? No 
matter how talented you are, everyone just 
gets lumped into the same single year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"The frontrunner from our generation is 
probably Ryan, right? The Mejiro family's 
rising star of speed..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Standing on the same stage as that? I 
wouldn't even joke about it~. I'm doing my 
best, but the skill gap is still just...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
An ultra-insane reality is closing in! 
There's only... one thing I can do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's run, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep, escaping reality! Resolutions are 
fine and all, but starting the year like 
this will just turn me back into the 
uptight version of myself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Something fun, I need something fun~... 
What's something fun that'll make me feel 
totally free~?

Mejiro Palmer desperately brainstormed a 
fun escape route. What suddenly came to 
mind was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fieldwork! Totally! We gotta channel these 
overflowing youth vibes straight into the 
soil!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's change and head out! 
Blazing lead, blazing run!

Dressed in her tracksuit, Mejiro Palmer 
darts outside with a phrase that sounds 
strangely familiar. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Urrrryaaaaaaah! Digging holes, pulling 
potatoes, muddy madness, woohoo-ooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Trainer, whaddya think? 
Look at this panoramic view.
choice_data_list:
Incredible... The field is completely full 
of holes in an instant.

That's amazing... The field was full of 
holes in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Behold one of my special skills, 'Digging 
Holes'! I've been great at it since I was 
little. I won't lose to anyone when it 
comes to tilling speed!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I wanna crawl into a hole and 
hide, this is the only way to go! Catch ya 
later, Trainer, once the dust settles!

She dug a hole at high speed and holed up 
inside just as quickly. Right at the start 
of the New Year, I witnessed an unexpected 
skill and speed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A shopping spree at a boutique! Sounds 
great, let's do it! The sales should be 
starting soon anyway!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There's actually something I've wanted for 
a while. Alright, I'll buy it to blow off 
some steam!
—And the place we headed to was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Look look, Trainer. This golf wear, great, 
right? Totally hypes you up, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, why don't we buy this 
and take a leisurely stroll around the 
course together? It'll make for a nice 
walk!"

On a golfwear shopping spree. Forgetting 
all about her upcoming race, Mejiro Palmer 
enjoyed herself in relaxed comfort.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Cafe! That's right! An extrovert's power 
always comes from chatting and sweets!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! All of a sudden, I'm 
craving that drink from back then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Um... so first, you mix iced tea and 
lemonade together...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All done! My favorite original blend is 
complete!
choice_data_list: Do you make that all the time?
Do you make that all the time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The Mejiro family scolded me, saying 
it was bad manners, but I just couldn't 
stop.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Personally, this is my top favorite, but 
there are plenty of other combinations 
too. Wanna give them a try?
choice_data_list: Yeah, since we have the chance...
Yeah, well, since we're at it...

text_block_list.text:
Cider with milk, cola with lemon tea... 
All of them were surprisingly delicious. 
The two of us enjoyed trying all the 
different combinations.
